name: G protein subunit alpha 12

function.text: GNA12 encodes guanine nucleotide-binding protein subunit alpha-12. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in Rho protein signal transduction and blood coagulation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
